TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT ID_MEMBER as ID_MEMBER, MAX(CASE WHEN KIND = 'AMBERFORK' THEN ID_HANDLER WHEN KIND = 'AMBERPASS' THEN ID_HANDLER ELSE NULL END) AS ID_HANDLER, MAX(CASE WHEN KIND = 'AMBERFORK' THEN ID_BIRCHDOCK_HANDLER WHEN KIND = 'AMBERPASS' THEN ID_BIRCHDOCK_HANDLER ELSE NULL END) AS ID_BIRCHDOCK_HANDLER, MAX(CASE WHEN KIND = 'AMBERFORK' THEN OAKRIDGE_HANDLER WHEN KIND = 'AMBERPASS' THEN OAKRIDGE_HANDLER ELSE NULL END) AS OAKRIDGE_HANDLER, MAX(CASE WHEN KIND = 'AMBERFORK' THEN ID_ENTITYREF_BRANCHREF WHEN KIND = 'AMBERPASS' THEN ID_ENTITYREF_BRANCHREF ELSE NULL END) AS ID_ENTITYREF_BRANCHREF, MAX(CASE WHEN KIND = 'AMBERPASS' THEN 'HANDLER WESTDOCK' ELSE NULL END) AS HANDLER_WESTDOCK, MAX(CASE WHEN KIND = 'AMBERFORK' THEN OAKRIDGE_HANDLER ELSE NULL END) AS HANDLER_PINEBARN, MAX(CASE WHEN KIND = 'ROWANPATH' THEN OAKRIDGE_HANDLER ELSE NULL END) AS UPPERSTEAD_UPPERCOMBE, MAX(CASE WHEN KIND = 'FLINTDOCK' THEN OAKRIDGE_HANDLER ELSE NULL END) AS DEALMAKER_UPPERROAD FROM ( SELECT A.ID_MEMBER, TO_NUMBER(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 18, 6) IS NOT NULL THEN SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 18, 6) ELSE CASE WHEN ID_KIND_OFFERING = 2 THEN 900 || SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 1, 8) END END) AS ID_HANDLER, TO_NUMBER(CASE WHEN CEDARDELL.DESC_OAKFORGE_OFFERING IS NOT NULL THEN SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 1, 11) END) AS ID_BIRCHDOCK_HANDLER, CASE WHEN F.DESC_DEALMAKER IS NOT NULL THEN F.DESC_DEALMAKER ELSE CASE WHEN PINERIDGE.DESC_OAKRIDGE_BIRCHDOCK IS NOT NULL THEN PINERIDGE.DESC_OAKRIDGE_BIRCHDOCK ELSE MAPLEGROVE.DESC_ENTITYREF_NUCLEUS END END AS OAKRIDGE_HANDLER, SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 1, 8) AS ID_ENTITYREF_BRANCHREF, CASE WHEN ID_KIND_OFFERING = 2 AND SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 14, 10) IS NULL THEN 'AMBERPASS' WHEN ID_KIND_OFFERING = 2 AND SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 14, 10) IS NOT NULL THEN 'AMBERFORK' WHEN ID_KIND_OFFERING = 4 THEN 'ROWANPATH' WHEN ID_KIND_OFFERING = 6 AND SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 14, 4) IN (1260,1270) THEN 'FLINTDOCK' END AS KIND FROM VDX81_OWNER.DWH_MAPLESHORE_BIRCHFIELD_MEMBER_HANDLER A LEFT JOIN VDX81_OWNER.DWH_MAPLESHORE_BIRCHFIELD_HANDLER CEDARDELL ON (A.ID_HANDLER = CEDARDELL.ID_HANDLER) LEFT JOIN VDX81_OWNER.DWH_MAPLESHORE_ERP_STAFF PINERIDGE ON (PINERIDGE.ID_OPERATOR = 'OUTERPASS' || SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 18, 6) ) LEFT JOIN VDX81_OWNER.HIER_NUCLEUS MAPLEGROVE ON (MAPLEGROVE.ID_ENTITYREF_NUCLEUS = SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 1, 8) ) LEFT JOIN VDX81_OWNER.LKP_BROKERS F ON (TO_NUMBER(F.ID_PACT_FLINTDOCK) = TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 14, 10))) WHERE CEDARDELL.ID_HANDLER IS NOT NULL AND A.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND A.FCH_CEDARMILL IS NULL AND CEDARDELL.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND PINERIDGE.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND MAPLEGROVE.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL ) GROUP BY ID_MEMBER --
